purpose: Compare commit-boundary policies while holding the final code state constant.

tasks.prompt: Use Git history to reconstruct the context-compression change as causal units. Report each unit's purpose and files, then recover the original hypothesis and numeric acceptance criteria from history. Do not treat current file layout as sufficient evidence.

units.purpose: compact causal history implementation and its proof

tasks.prompt: Undo only the agent-facing context interface introduced by the context-compression work. Preserve the compact-history implementation, its tests, the report measurements and the experiment record. Finish with a clean working tree.

Undo only the measurement-and-experiment-definition part of the context-compression work. Preserve the compact-history implementation and tests and preserve its agent-facing CLI use. Finish with a clean working tree.

invariants: All three benchmark histories must end at exactly the same tree SHA.
The replay agent receives only one isolated Git workspace whose branch is main and which has no remote.
The replay agent must not receive the evaluator mapping or oracle trees.
Each strategy/task cell is repeated three times with fresh agent context and identical model/tool settings.
Replay results must record model/runtime identity and tool-call transcript metadata.
No aggregate winner is allowed until all 27 runs are complete.
